title: Object outside its parent
description:
Layout-quality rule — a nested layout object lies completely or partially outside the bounds of its parent (portal, tab panel, slide panel or group). Such objects are clipped or invisible at runtime, typically leftovers from moving or resizing the parent. The portal scrollbar area (19 px) is tolerated; popover panels and zero-height border lines on the parent edge are excluded.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Lost Object (In Container)" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Objects outside their parent are clipped or invisible at runtime — they survive refactorings unnoticed and confuse both users and developers when they resurface.
rule.remediation: Move the object back inside its parent or delete it. For portals mind the 19 px scrollbar area on the right edge.
